# The Claravie Support

> The Claravie Support (TCS) is a Belize-based business support service for micro, small and medium-sized businesses. It provides flexible business administration, compliance and digital operations support, delivered remotely from Belmopan, with in-person consultations by arrangement only. Tagline: Clear support. Bold progress.

TCS focuses on clarity, practical systems and progress that business owners can maintain. It supports independent operators, growing teams and women-led enterprises. TCS does not provide specialist legal or tax advice, and refers work that needs a licensed professional.

## Pages

- [Home](https://claraviesupport.com/): What TCS does, the four areas of support, how the process works and answers to common questions.
- [Packages](https://claraviesupport.com/packages.html): Support options: Starter Compass, Focused Business Projects, Navigator Retainer and Virtual Assistant Hour Blocks, plus the free Business Clarity Check and free 30-minute Business Clarity Call.
- [About](https://claraviesupport.com/about.html): Why TCS exists, the experience behind the approach, what clients can expect and which businesses TCS works with.
- [Free Business Clarity Check](https://claraviesupport.com/check-up.html): A short check-up of eight questions to spot areas of a business worth reviewing. It is a starting point for reflection, not a formal compliance assessment or audit.
- [Contact](https://claraviesupport.com/contact.html): Contact form, email, phone and location.

## Areas of support

- Business Processes and Administration: records, forms, daily tasks and routines kept organized.
- Compliance and Regulatory Support: learning applicable business rules, organizing documents and tracking important dates.
- Digital Operations and Data: choosing and setting up suitable digital tools and reducing manual steps.
- Inventory and Ongoing Business Support: stock records, tracking and routine follow-through.
